title: CliSubcommand
description: A verb's declaration: rsc/cli/<command>/<verb>.json. Its filename is the verb, and its directory is the command, so neither is a field here. Subcommands render in listing order, which is alphabetical — the filesystem offers no other, and that is why ordering stops being a check.

help.description: The one-line description of what this verb does, shown beneath the command's forms.

step.description: Names the pipeline this verb is a corpus-wide step of, when it is one. src/main/pipeline.sh --plan must invoke it by command AND verb (G10).

args.description: The verb's arguments, in the order they render in its usage.

sends.description: Outward calls this declaration makes — one line per call, naming it and its effect (#29). A send has no scratch form: redirecting where the result lands does not stop the call going out, so YOGA_NO_SEND=1 refuses it — reads degrade to UNVERIFIED, writes refuse loudly (src/main/send.py, src/main/send.sh).
